request.style: English, female solo voice with gospel choir, Hammond organ, electric piano, drums, bass guitar, warm and majestic, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Oh the depth of the riches and wisdom
And knowledge of God revealed to us
His judgments are unsearchable
His ways remain untraceable

[Chorus]
For from him and through him
And to him are all things
To him be the glory
Forever and ever

[Verse]
Who has known the mind of the Lord
Or who has been his counselor
Who has ever given to him
That he should be repaid

[Chorus]
For from him and through him
And to him are all things
To him be the glory
Forever and ever

[Bridge]
He has consigned all to disobedience
So that he may have mercy on all
Mercy shown to you now
Is shown to them as well

[Chorus]
For from him and through him
And to him are all things
To him be the glory
Forever and ever

[Outro]
Amen to his glory
Forever and ever
